_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or derived from extracted values by a rule stated beside it.

families.basis: unrelated families those individuals came from

genematcher_individuals.basis: individuals the paper says were found through GeneMatcher after the first

variants_modeled.basis: patient missense variants modeled in fruit flies

training_variants_m.basis: millions of variants AI-MARRVEL's classifier was trained on, over

cohorts.basis: real-world cohorts in which AI-MARRVEL doubled the solved cases

precision_pct.basis: precision of AI-MARRVEL's confidence metric, percent, NOT overall accuracy

diagnosable_found_pct.basis: percent of diagnosable cases the confidence metric identified

metric_cases.basis: cases in the collection the confidence metric was tested on

texome_visits.basis: study visits a Texome participant makes

gift_card_dollars.basis: dollars of the gift card after all the visits

texome_target_children.basis: children Texome plans to sequence, a target with a tilde, never a count served

followup_months_first.basis: months to the first Texome re-evaluation

solved_multiplier.basis: the paper's word 'doubling', as a factor, drawn as two lengths at one scale and never printed as a numeral

first_plus_matched.basis: the first Texome individual plus the nine found through GeneMatcher, computed only to assert it equals the release's 10, never printed
